content: A vast, fog-covered marshland stretching south of Millhaven. Local legend speaks of will-o-wisps that lure travelers off the road. The peat bogs are said to preserve the dead, and more than one traveler has reported hearing voices in the mist.

An annual celebration in Millhaven marking the end of the harvest. This year the festival was cancelled — officially due to poor harvest, unofficially due to the bandit activity on Swamp Road cutting off supply caravans.
